(i) chromatin regulators can be used to predict docetaxel treatment response; (ii) the expression of key chromatin regulators is predictive of docetaxels response in the NCI60 panel of cell lines and (iii) loss of the SWi/SNF subunit SMARCA4 sensitizes cells to docetaxel.
chromatin regulators are a guide to cancer treatment choice, as they predict drug response and can be used to sensitize patients towards chemotherapy.
chromatin regulators, and in particular SWI/SNF complex subunits, are a useful tool to predict docetaxel treatment outcome.

the development of new approaches to improve cancer treatment.
